demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- The outlook for the laminates industry remains positive, with the sector expected to grow at a CAGR of 8-10% over the next 5 years.
- Government spending on smart cities, commercial spaces, and housing, along with growing consumer preference for stylish and durable interiors, will further fuel demand.
- Growing housing demand under government initiatives like Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana.
- Rising demand for modular furniture and modern office interiors.
- Expanding export opportunities for premium laminates.
- Shift towards green building materials and sustainable products.
- During the year under review, …

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The Company is exposed to volatility in raw material prices such as paper, resins, and chemicals.
- Management flags exposure to a global economic slowdown as a risk to the business.
- Both organized and unorganized competitors intensify pricing and market-share pressure in the laminates segment.
- Export exposure and cross-border sourcing leave the Company sensitive to trade-policy and currency shifts.
- Substitutes such as paints, coatings, and other decorative materials compete with laminates for the same end demand.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- The Company is committed to introducing innovative, value-added products while enhancing its distribution network in domestic and overseas markets.
- Strategic sourcing, hedging practices, and continuous product innovation are being implemented to mitigate raw material and competitive risks.
